mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, year, week_no, start_date, end_date, completed_task_count, visibility_scope, team_id, focus_project_id, focus_project_name, shared_summary, reflection, next_plan, create_time, update_time FROM weekly_review WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, user_id, year, week_no, start_date, end_date, completed_task_count, visibility_scope, team_id, focus_project_id, focus_project_name, shared_summary, reflection, next_plan, create_time, update_time FROM weekly_review WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND year = #{year} AND week_no = #{weekNo} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE weekly_review SET visibility_scope = #{visibilityScope}, team_id = #{teamId}, focus_project_id = #{focusProjectId}, focus_project_name = #{focusProjectName}, shared_summary = #{sharedSummary}, reflection = #{reflection}, next_plan = #{nextPlan}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT wr.id AS review_id, wr.user_id AS author_id, u.username AS author_username, wr.year AS review_year, wr.week_no AS review_week_no, wr.start_date AS review_start_date, wr.end_date AS review_end_date, fp.id AS focus_project_id, fp.name AS focus_project_name, wr.shared_summary AS shared_summary, wr.create_time AS review_create_time, wr.update_time AS review_update_time FROM weekly_review wr LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = wr.user_id AND u.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN project fp ON fp.id = wr.focus_project_id AND fp.team_id = wr.team_id AND fp.is_delete = 0 AND fp.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE wr.team_id = #{teamId} AND BINARY wr.visibility_scope = BINARY 'TEAM' ORDER BY wr.year DESC, wr.week_no DESC, wr.id DESC
